requirement.value: Three legend options from the same caps: C64 legends (original 75% set plus a C64 add-on), plain standard legends (dark inlays on light caps), and blanks
requirement.description: Every layout comes in three looks: C64 legends, plain legends, or blank.

requirement.value: The C64 numpad Enter says RETURN, one letter per row, upright on the 2u cap
requirement.description: The C64 numpad Enter reads RETURN, stacked one letter per row.

requirement.value: C64 add-on: TKL nav, 17-key numpad, full-size right mods (2.75u Shift, 1.25u mods) and tsangan mods, in the C64 colours and font
requirement.description: A C64-style add-on brings the C64 look to TKL, full-size and tsangan boards.

requirement.value: Plain set: light caps (#d9d4c7) with dark inlaid legends (#2a2a2a); letters 4.2 mm, modifiers 2.8 mm, F keys 3.6 mm, shifted symbol stacked over the base one
requirement.description: Plain caps are light grey-beige with dark inlaid legends in standard PC naming.

requirement.value: The project guide 'kits' lists which groups and caps to print for 60%, 65%, 75%, TKL, full size and tsangan, per legend option
requirement.description: A kit map says which caps to print for each board size.
